updateAvailableMessage: A new version of KoBar ({version}) is available. Would you like to download and install it?
alreadyLatest: You are already using the latest version of KoBar.
updateError: An error occurred while checking for updates.
restartInstallDesc: The update has been downloaded. Restart the application to apply the update.
settingsLanguageHint: System language is the display language of Windows.
settingsShowTipsDesc: Short labels when you point at a button
settingsLaunchAtStartupDesc: Opens KoBar when you sign in to Windows
settingsWorkspacesAbout: A workspace saves a KoBar layout (theme, sizes, enabled plugins). A shared workspace uses the same notes and plugin data as everything else. An isolated workspace keeps its own notes and plugin data, separate from the others. This is not a privacy boundary: installed plugins can still read other workspaces.
settingsWorkspacesDeleteSharedNote: This workspace uses shared data, so your shared notes and plugin data are not affected.
settingsPluginsUpToDate: All plugins are up to date.
settingsPluginsSettingsHint: Opens the plugin's settings in the KoBar window.
settingsPluginsUninstallBody: The plugin and its files will be removed. KoBar may ask you to confirm once more.
settingsPluginsDiscoverOfflineBody: Connect to the internet and try again.
settingsPluginsDiscoverError: The plugin catalogue could not be loaded
settingsPluginsDiscoverErrorBody: Please try again in a moment.
settingsPluginsDiscoverEmpty: The catalogue has no plugins yet.
pluginHostInstallPrompt: Would you like to install the plugin {name}?
pluginHostErrNoAsset: No .zip asset or source code found in the latest release.
pluginHostErrNotFound: Plugin not found at the provided link.
pluginHostErrCheck: Failed to check the GitHub repository.
pluginHostErrUnexpected: An unexpected error occurred during installation.
settingsCustomColorInvalid: Enter a hex color such as #3a7bd5.
settingsCustomColorAdjusted: Slightly adjusted so text stays readable.
settingsTransparencyHint: Makes the bar and panel backgrounds slightly see-through.
settingsDensityHint: Sets the size of the bar and its buttons.
settingsOrientationHint: Changing the orientation moves the bar to its default edge.
settingsFeatureOrderHint: Order of the buttons on the bar. Use the arrows to move a button.
slotsMinMaxInfo: Changes are applied immediately. Min: 4, Max: 20 slots.
deleteConfirmMsg: Are you sure you want to delete this note?
launchAtStartupStoreNote: In the Microsoft Store version, startup is managed in Windows Settings > Apps > Startup
failedToFetchRates: Failed to fetch rates. Using offline backup.
hideOnScreenshotDesc: Hide KoBar during Screenshot. Use Ctrl+Shift+S or PrintScreen to hide and snip.
hardwareAccelerationDesc: Requires restart. Turn off if you see a black screen over videos.
systemMessageDesc: Acts as core identity for the AI
customInstructionsDesc: Added to every request as context
placeholderSysMsg: e.g., You are a helpful senior developer who explains concepts simply. Always use bullet points.
placeholderCustInst: e.g., I am a React developer using Windows. I prefer TypeScript over JavaScript. Keep answers concise.
featureAddedSoon: This feature will be added soon
aiHubEmptyState: Send a message or drop files (TXT, PDF, Images) to start chatting.
autoAddClipboardDesc: Automatically send picked colors to the Sequential Clipboard slots.
requiresCopyPaste: Requires "Copy & Paste" feature to be enabled.
todoListDesc: A minimal, draggable to-do list widget stored sequentially to prioritize your tasks.
pinToTopDesc: When activated, the next third-party window you click on will be pinned so it's "Always on Top" (or unpinned if already pinned).
snippetVaultDesc: Quickly access your saved templates, AI prompts, code snippets, or texts. You can seamlessly shoot them into your sequential clipboard slots.
aiHubDesc: OS-level floating AI companion. Connects to OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and local LLMs.
todoEmptyState: All caught up! Add a task to start.
focusModeFinishedDesc: Your focus session has ended. Take a break!
noEventsFound: No events found from this date.
playSomething: Play something in Spotify, YouTube, or any media player
isolateDataDesc: Keeps this workspace's data separate. Not a privacy boundary: installed plugins can still read and change other workspaces.
workspaceDeleteConfirm: Delete the layout "{name}"? Its saved settings are removed. An automatic backup of all your data is saved first.
workspaceDeleteIsoNote: Its isolated notes, chat history and the plugin data stored only in this layout are deleted too.
workspaceDeleteActiveNote: This layout is active: KoBar switches to shared data and plugins reload.
workspaceDeletedMsg: Layout "{name}" deleted. A backup was saved first.
workspaceDeleteBackupFailed: The automatic backup failed, so "{name}" was not deleted. Nothing was changed.
workspaceIsolateConfirm: Isolate the data of "{name}"? This layout gets its own notes and plugin data; plugins start empty here (or with its earlier isolated data). Shared data is not changed.
workspaceShareConfirm: Switch "{name}" to shared data? It will use the shared notes and plugin data. Its isolated data is kept and comes back if you isolate it again.
workspaceToggleActiveNote: This layout is active: plugins reload.
aboutContact: For any inquiries, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact us at:
aboutCredits: Special thanks to: Tolunay PARLAK & MJ.
smartPopupPositioningDesc: Popups dynamically follow their launch icons and stay within screen bounds. If disabled, popups stay rigidly centered to the Bar.
exportSettingsDesc: Backup your layout, themes, and feature toggles.
importInvalidFile: The file could not be imported: it is not a valid KoBar export.
noteExportFailedBody: The note could not be saved as text.
exportDataDesc: Backup the notes of the current workspace.
fullBackupDesc: Save notes, settings, workspaces and plugin data to one file. KoBox files are not included.
fullBackupSecretsWarning: Warning: the file will contain your API keys and passwords in plain text. Anyone who gets the file can use them. Keep it private.
fullBackupFailed: The full backup could not be saved.
pluginNeedsAppUpdate: Please update KoBar to install this plugin.
pluginUpdatesAllUpToDate: All plugins are up to date.
pluginUpdatesOriginUnverifiedHint: Installed before KoBar recorded plugin sources. The update repository comes from the plugin's own manifest.
backupHint: Take a full backup of your data. Use the Backup section below.
backupRestoreDesc: Load a full backup file created by KoBar. Only use files you created yourself.
backupWarnOwn: Only restore files you created yourself. A backup can change how KoBar and its plugins behave.
backupWarnNewer: This backup comes from a newer KoBar version. Some data may not be restored.
backupWarnSecrets: This backup contains API keys and passwords.
backupWarnSecretsLocal: API keys and passwords are not in this backup; your current ones are kept.
backupWarnMissingPlugins: Plugins not installed (their data is skipped):
backupWarnEndpoint: A server address in this backup differs from yours, so your current API key for it will not be carried over. Enter the key again after the restore.
backupWarnUnknownVersion: The KoBar version of this backup could not be determined.
backupWarnRedactedText: Some key-like texts (for example in notes) were replaced with a placeholder when the backup was made.
backupWarnCoreMissing: This backup contains no main app data (notes and settings); your current ones stay as they are.
backupWarnCoreSkipped: The main app data (notes and settings) in this backup could not be used; your current ones stay as they are.
backupWarnCoreDropped: Some invalid settings or notes in this backup were left out.
backupWarnForbidden: Some unsafe entries in this backup were removed.
backupWarnPluginList: The plugin list in this backup is damaged; some plugin information is missing.
backupWarnExtConfig: The plugin on/off settings in this backup are damaged and are ignored.
backupWarnPluginFlags: {count} plugin enable settings in this backup were not carried over: those plugins are off or not installed here.
backupSkipPlugin: belongs to a plugin that is not installed or unknown
backupConfirmBody: Your current notes, settings and plugin data will be replaced with this backup. A backup of your current data is created automatically first. Plugins are not installed or enabled by the restore. KoBar will restart when it finishes.
backupErrInvalid: This file is not a valid KoBar backup.
backupErrTooLarge: This file is too large to be a KoBar backup.
backupErrNewer: This backup was made by a newer KoBar version. Update KoBar and try again.
backupErrRead: The file could not be read.
backupRestoreFailed: The restore failed. Your data was not changed.
backupRestoreFailedPartial: The restore failed and your data may be partly changed. A backup of your data from before the restore is in the KoBar data folder under backups (file name starts with kobar-full-backup.pre-restore.).
onboardingWelcomeBody: KoBar lives on the edge of your screen. Move the pointer there to open it.
onboardingBarBody: Take quick notes from the bar and add features with plugins. Everything stays on your device.
onboardingPackBody: Install what you like with one click. KoBar asks for your approval before each install. You can skip this and add plugins later.
notesEmptyBody: Write something down. Your notes stay on this device.
onboardingOffline: You are offline. You can finish now and install plugins later from Settings.
onboardingFailed: The plugin list could not be loaded. You can finish now and try again later.
tutorialFarewellMessage: I am leaving, but you can activate the tutorial anytime from the settings ;)
tutorialStep0Message: Hey!\nWould you like me to briefly show you KoBar's features?
tutorialStep1Message: You need to click the 'Notch' to access Notes, Settings, and Plugins.
tutorialStep2Message: You can take quick notes here.
tutorialStep3Message: You can access KoBar's settings using the button on the top right.
tutorialStep4Message: You can personalize KoBar's appearance, shortcuts, and behaviors from the settings panel.
tutorialStep5Message: You can add new features to KoBar and expand your workspace from the plugins tab.
tutorialStep6Message: You can manage your installed plugins here. You have completed the tutorial!
hydrationFailedTitle: KoBar could not read your saved settings
hydrationFailedBody: Your saved data on disk is untouched; changes made in this session will NOT be saved. Restart the app or contact support.
recoveryBody: Your saved data was not changed and this session is not being saved. Choose how to continue.
recoveryReopen: Settings could not be loaded: show options
recoveryBackupsHint: KoBar also keeps automatic copies in the backups folder inside its data folder.
recoveryFreshConfirmBody: KoBar will continue with default settings and save your changes again. Your unreadable data is not deleted: a full copy is kept in KoBar's storage, and a copy without secrets in the automatic backups.
recoveryCopyFailed: KoBar could not keep a copy of your unreadable data, so nothing was changed. You can keep using KoBar with “Continue without saving”. Automatic backups (secrets masked) are in the backups folder of KoBar's data folder.
recoveryFreshFailed: KoBar could not start fresh. Nothing was changed.
persistFailedTitle: KoBar could not save your changes
persistFailedBody: KoBar could not save your latest changes (storage is unavailable). Your changes may be lost when you close the app. Export or back up your data and restart the app.
persistFailedQuotaBody: KoBar could not save your latest changes (storage is full). Your changes may be lost when you close the app. Export or back up your data and delete notes, images or other content you no longer need in KoBar.
pluginPanelMoveHandle: Move panel: drag, or press Alt with an arrow key. Double-click to reset.
noteSaveFailed: Could not save the note as a text file.
noteImportTooLarge: {name} is larger than {limit} MB and was not imported.
aboutSponsorsBody: Want to become a sponsor? Write to us:
gcalDesc: Shows your Google Calendar events (read-only) in calendar plugins. KoBar never changes your calendar. Off by default.
gcalStateNotConfigured: Not configured: this build has no Google client settings.
gcalStateReconnect: Reconnect needed: Google rejected the saved sign-in.
gcalReconnectNote: While the Google app is in Testing mode, the sign-in expires after 7 days. Connect again to continue.
gcalFailEncryption: This computer cannot encrypt the sign-in safely, so KoBar will not connect.
gcalFailBusy: A sign-in is already in progress.
gcalFailTimeout: The sign-in took too long (5 minutes). Try again.
gcalFailDenied: The sign-in was cancelled or denied.
gcalFailGeneric: Could not complete the request. Try again.
